citation.authors: Kindred C, Oresajo CO, Yatskayer M, Halder RM

record.design: Randomised, split-face trial comparing three depilatory compositions with a manual razor
record.finding: The depilatory creams produced fewer papules and more irritation than the razor; the irritation was transient. One composition was withdrawn because of a high rate of adverse events. Skin looked and felt smoother with the creams. The authors recommend depilatories for people who develop PFB or are unsatisfied with razors.
record.note: One week only, preliminary (the abstract's own wording). Funding and author affiliations not checked.
